evidence: Library shows 6 templates (e.g. "Professional Resume" by Sarah Chen with description) each with author and description.
Card "Professional Resume": category Resume, scenario Business, author Sarah Chen, 1,250 uses, Updated 2024-12-01, description present.
Clicking "Use Template" opened dialog "Professional Resume" with details (category, scenario, author, uses, description) and a Fill Template form with 14 fields.
With empty fields, panel shows "Required fields missing - Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, ... Skills" and the "Preview Result" tab is disabled.
All 14 fields of Professional Resume (incl. optional Phone/End Date) accepted typed values.
After filling required fields the Preview Result tab enabled and rendered the resume with Jane Doe / Tech Corp / MIT values substituted.

issue: Declared email-format field accepts invalid value; no validation gate
actual: Email input (input type=email, checkValidity()=false) with value "not-an-email" produced no error message; the Preview Result tab became enabled and the preview rendered "not-an-email" in the contact line.

evidence: Copy to Clipboard wrote raw Markdown source ("# Jane Doe\n\n**Software Engineer** | ...") via clipboard.writeText and showed toast "Copied to clipboard!".
Resume (Markdown) preview: no unresolved {{placeholders}}; h1/h2/h3 headings, strong, emphasis, horizontal separator and paragraph breaks all rendered.

issue: Markdown special characters in field values are neither rejected nor escaped
actual: Entering "# Hacked **Name** ---" in Full Name was accepted with no warning; generated Markdown became "# # Hacked **Name** ---" and the preview rendered "Name" as bold inside the H1, i.e. user input altered the generated Markdown structure.

issue: Preview gate checks only nonblank, not validity
actual: Blank/whitespace-only required values correctly disable Preview ("Please fill in: Full Name"), but with required Email = "not-an-email" (input type=email, invalid) the Preview tab was enabled and generated output, so preview is available before every required field has a valid value.

evidence: Heart buttons on 2 cards toggled to filled/active state, header count went to 2, and Favorites button opened a favorites-only list showing exactly those 2 templates.
In favorites-only view: search "weekly" -> only Weekly Status Report; category filter Resume -> only Professional Resume (count "Showing 1 of 6").

Favoriting filled the heart (class fill-current, bg-primary/10) and header badge went 0->1->2; unfavoriting immediately dropped badge to 1, removed the card from the favorites list ("No favorites yet", Showing 0 of 6) and updated localStorage.

Category=Resume -> 1 result; Scenario=Academic -> "Showing 1 of 6" (Academic Research Summary); Sort: Recently Updated (12-05..09-30), Alphabetical (A..W), Oldest First = createdAt ascending (Email 01-08 ... Academic 05-12).
Typing "me" showed live suggestion list (Professional Resume, Full Name, Company Name, Your Name, Department); clicking "Professional Resume" set the query and narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6".

issue: No typo tolerance / fuzzy matching in search
actual: Query "resme" (typo of resume) -> "No templates found", "Showing 0 of 6", no suggestions. Query "meetng" (typo of meeting) -> same empty result with no suggestion list, although "Meeting Minutes" exists.

evidence: Search text, category/scenario filters, favorites-only toggle and all 4 sort options changed cards and the "Showing X of 6" count instantly; window marker set before the interactions survived (performance navigation entries = 1), proving no reload.
Plain-text Professional Email preview rendered in <pre class="whitespace-pre-wrap"> preserving all line breaks; Markdown resume preview rendered headings/bold/italic/hr as HTML.

Empty submit blocked with "Missing required fields"; with title/author/description/content filled but no fields, submit blocked with "No fields defined – Please add at least one template field." Library stayed at 6.

issue: No placeholder/field consistency validation; previews contain unresolved placeholders
actual: Submitted "QA Sprint Notes" whose content used {{sprintName}}, {{owner}}, {{summary}} while the only declared field generated key {{sprint_name}}. Submission succeeded ("Template submitted!"). Using the template, the preview rendered "Sprint Notes: {{sprintName}} ... Owner: {{owner}} ... {{summary}}" — unresolved placeholders, and the declared field had no effect.

evidence: Submitted Markdown template "QA Release Report" with title, description, author (QA Bot), category Other, scenario Business, content and 4 defined fields; toast "Template submitted!" and library grew to 8.
On submit the count changed "Showing 7 of 7" -> "Showing 8 of 8" and the new card appeared instantly; pre-set window marker survived (no reload).

issue: Duplicate field labels neither rejected nor disambiguated; fields not independently fillable
actual: Adding "Release Name" twice was accepted (both shown with identical key {{release_name}}), the template submitted successfully, and in the fill form typing "v2.1.0" into the first Release Name input immediately mirrored the same value into the second field (shared id); console errors also appeared.

evidence: Custom "QA Release Report" appeared in the library, opened via Use Template, fields filled, and preview rendered "Release Report: v2.1.0 / Owner: Jane Smith / Notes ..." with h1, hr and strong elements.

After a real reload (in-page marker gone), library still shows 8 templates including custom "QA Release Report" and "QA Sprint Notes"; Favorites badge = 1 and favorites view lists Weekly Status Report.
